rca of the issue: Prior iteration_6 flag was a mis-interpretation: querySelector('#error-toast') returns the toast host container that expo-router / RN mounts globally to render future error toasts; it is present on every screen with empty content and 0x0 layout. Actual page errors and visible toast only appear when the container has children. Iteration_7 verified: innerHTML length = 0, bounding rect 0x0 on every tab, and pageerror + console.error listeners captured 0 entries.
